# Preflyt

> Engineering confidence before production. Preflyt is a self-hosted Shift Left engineering platform by Lyrisoft Technologies that helps teams find security, quality, reliability and infrastructure risks earlier, using explicit engineering standards and traceable evidence at exact commits.

Preflyt coordinates existing scanners and CI rather than replacing them. It is not a coding agent, an IDE or a CI platform. Its main output is an evidence-backed account of which required engineering checks passed, failed, were not applicable or lacked evidence at a specific repository revision. AI may explain findings but never decides a gate result.

## Available today

- GitHub App installation with explicit repository selection
- Commit-pinned repository profiles: languages, frameworks, CI, tests, lockfiles, containers, infrastructure as code and scanner configuration, each with file evidence
- Engineering Standards Library: five versioned packs (Baseline Engineering, Application Security, Backend Services, Frontend Applications, Infrastructure as Code) with profile-based recommendations, adopted in observe mode
- Exact-commit assessment snapshots, created manually or automatically for pull request head commits
- Signed GitHub pull request and CI webhook ingestion with revision-bound check and workflow results
- Automatic bounded JUnit and SARIF submissions authenticated with GitHub OIDC and verified against the actual workflow, run attempt, commit and completed jobs; optional additional report signatures
- Observe by default; optional readiness check publication and ruleset activation using the primary GitHub App with organization administration permission; a separate governance App is optional
- GitHub or OIDC sign-in, organizations, teams and role-based access control
- Self-hosted deployment with Docker Compose or a single-instance Kubernetes bundle

- Public Preflyt Action v1.1.0: github.com/marketplace/actions/preflyt-policy-check; source github.com/lyrisoft/preflyt-action. Check submission and the terminal final gate share one PR workflow.
- Paginated scoped Audit log and advisory PR AI reviews with explicit code-sharing consent

## Onboarding

Deploy with private GHCR package access, configure one GitHub App as Super Admin, sign in as a verified GitHub organization owner, select repositories, create standards and publish a target-branch policy, add the generated workflow, and verify a same-repository non-draft PR. Optional AI and merge protection follow. Native execution and external report signers are not prerequisites. See https://docs.preflytlabs.com/getting-started/ and https://docs.preflytlabs.com/user-guide/native-execution.

## Not yet available

- Native execution production acceptance: fixed adapters are implemented and fixture-tested; complete analyzer coverage, independent effective isolation review and production runtime acceptance remain outstanding
- Helm and Operator packaging for Kubernetes
